scripts.title: Infinite Stamina Open Sourced
scripts.script:
local aux = loadstring(game:HttpGetAsync("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Upbolt/Hydroxide/revision/ohaux.lua"))()

local scriptPath = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Client.Combat
local closureName = "new"
local upvalueIndex = 1

local closureConstants = {
    [1] = "setmetatable",
    [2] = aux.placeholderUserdataConstant,
    [3] = "state",
    [4] = "previousState",
    [5] = "Moveset",
    [6] = "GetAttribute"
}

local closure = aux.searchClosure(scriptPath, closureName, upvalueIndex, closureConstants)

local value = 1
local elementIndex = "DrainStamina"

local upvalue = debug.getupvalue(closure, upvalueIndex)
if upvalue then
    upvalue[elementIndex] = value
else
    warn("Error: Upvalue or closure not found.")
end
